headword: {東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}
gloss: rushing about busily; running around everywhere

definitions.gloss: rushing about busily; running around in all directions
definitions.explanation: To run about busily from place to place trying to get things done. A four-character idiom (yojijukugo) expressing energetic but hectic activity.

examples.japanese: {東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}する{毎日|まいにち}だ。
examples.english: Every day is spent rushing about.

examples.japanese: {資金集|しきんあつ}めのために{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}した。
examples.english: I ran around everywhere to raise funds.

examples.japanese: イベントの{準備|じゅんび}で{東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}して、{疲|つか}れ{果|は}てた。
examples.english: I was completely exhausted from rushing around preparing for the event.

notes: A {四字熟語|よじじゅくご} (four-character compound). {東|ひがし} (east) + {奔|ほん} (run) + {西|にし} (west) + {走|そう} (run) — literally running east and west. Used as a する verb: {東奔西走|とうほんせいそう}する. Implies being very busy dealing with various matters in different locations. Related: {奔走|ほんそう}する (to run about, to make efforts).
